notice: Illustrative starter questions only. Not source-grounded, independently audited, verified against an official GATE syllabus, or suitable as a GATE mock test.

questions.text: Which bond primarily stabilizes the α-helix structure in a protein?
questions.explanation: The α-helix is stabilized by hydrogen bonds between backbone carbonyl and amide groups.

questions.text: Which of the following are pyrimidine bases found in nucleic acids?
questions.explanation: Cytosine and thymine are pyrimidines; adenine and guanine are purines.

questions.text: A solution contains 0.5 mol of solute in 2 L. What is its concentration in mol L⁻¹?
questions.explanation: Molarity is moles of solute divided by solution volume: 0.5 / 2 = 0.25 mol L⁻¹.

questions.text: Which enzyme synthesizes RNA using a DNA template during transcription?
questions.explanation: RNA polymerase reads the DNA template strand and catalyzes RNA synthesis.

questions.text: In Michaelis–Menten kinetics, Km is the substrate concentration at which the reaction velocity is:
questions.explanation: Km is defined as the substrate concentration at which velocity reaches half of Vmax.
